## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (95%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set [F1] and 0% invasive risk, though all 5 nearest cases are Normal.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 95%, Normal 5%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%, n = 132) | Strong Benign call; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Benign} at α = 10% (90% dataset coverage [76%–98%], n = 132) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 99%, OOD 8th percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] (error AUROC 70%) | Typical input; no quality flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | True (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (0%); all 5 Normal (94%–96% similarity) [F5] | Mismatch: neighbors are all Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↓ invasive · Score 1.55 (contribution -1.41) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score 1.35 (contribution -0.56) [F3]; 18/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 8) · ↑ invasive · Below-typical score -0.14 yields small shift (+0.29) [F4]; 12/20 spot check · Weak
- **Nuclear size** (regions 0, 3, 10) · context · Mean 48.6 µm² at 0th reference percentile [F7]; 15/21 cell spot check · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions beat random removal (+0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021 to 0.0197, n = 132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to 0.0064); leans on unreliable normal lobules (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal (like all 5 nearest neighbors) or contains focal atypia in regions 3, 8, or 10.
- Simulated frozen-section margins are called clear [F8], but the medial margin at (x=0, y=256) scores 91%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 0**: Inspect the medial margin at (x=0, y=256) (91% score) and superior margin (17%).
2. **Regions 3, 8, 9**: Verify benign tubules versus ductal atypia (region 8) and 61 neoplastic-called nuclei (region 3).
3. **Regions 1, 5, 10, 11**: Confirm lobules directly (unreliable concept) and check region 10 (0.001 risk; 0.46 pleomorphism).
